Location: Jakarta

Employment Type: Project-Based / Contract

Experience: Minimum 2 years

Project Duration: 3–6 months, depending on project requirements



About the role

We are looking for a Frontend Developer to join our project-based team and contribute to the development and enhancement of our digital applications.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in building applications using Next.js and Flutter, is comfortable working independently as well as collaboratively, and has strong attention to detail when developing responsive, scalable, and user-friendly applications.

You will be directly involved in the development lifecycle, from understanding requirements and implementing UI/UX designs to API integration, testing, debugging, and deployment.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop and enhance web and mobile applications

  • Translate UI/UX designs into responsive and user-friendly interfaces

  • Develop web applications using Next.js / React.js

  • Develop mobile applications using Flutter / Dart

  • Integrate applications with REST APIs and backend services

  • Implement application state management, authentication, form validation, and error handling

  • Perform debugging, troubleshooting, and application optimization

  • Conduct testing and ensure application quality before production release

  • Collaborate with Backend Developers, UI/UX Designers, QA Engineers, and Project Managers

  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-structured code following development best practices

About you

  • Minimum 2 years of experience as a Frontend Developer, Mobile Developer, or similar role

  • Hands-on experience with Next.js / React.js

  • Hands-on experience with Flutter / Dart

  • Good understanding of REST APIs and API integration

  • Familiarity with Git / GitHub / GitLab and version control

  • Good understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript/TypeScript

  • Good understanding of responsive web design and mobile UI/UX principles

  • Ability to independently debug and troubleshoot technical issues

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills

  • Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively within a team


Pertanyaan dari perusahaan

Lamaran kamu akan mencakup pertanyaan-pertanyaan berikut:
  • Pernyataan mana di bawah ini yang paling mendeskripsikan hakmu bekerja di Indonesia?
  • Berapa gaji bulanan yang kamu inginkan?
  • Berapa tahun pengalaman kerjamu sebagai pengembang frontend?
  • Kualifikasi mana yang kamu miliki?
  • Berapa tahun pengalaman kerjamu di bidang pengembangan front end?
  • Apakah kamu memiliki pengalaman Pengujian Jaminan Kualitas?
  • Apakah kamu memiliki pengalaman Integrasi API?
  • Apakah kamu memiliki pengalaman menggunakan Next.JS?
  • How many years' experience do you have as a React.JS System Analyst?
